disclosure: Maya Chen, Aperture House, all evaluation events and all values are synthetic. They demonstrate the proposed measurement and experience contract, not real inference quality.

current_portrait.headline: Your creative judgement is becoming transferable.
current_portrait.body: The Brain can now recognise several kinds of polished work you would still reject, and it has started to carry the reason into unfamiliar launch decisions.
current_portrait.change_sentence: One part became clearer. Another became more honest.
current_portrait.earned_sentence: This now holds on unfamiliar examples.
current_portrait.honest_limit: It still cannot reliably identify the first detail that tells you a direction is wrong.
current_portrait.healthy_uncertainty: The interpretation that you resist delegation weakened after your correction. That reduced certainty and improved the Brain.
current_portrait.next_contrast: Which direction is closer to something you would put your name to, and what would still stop you shipping it?

territories.name: Creative direction
territories.evidence_sentence: Three unfamiliar launch directions were read correctly or deferred with appropriate uncertainty.
territories.honest_limit: Only one transfer attempt exists, and Maya still supplied the final edit.

territories.name: Editorial voice
territories.evidence_sentence: The Brain distinguishes Maya's direct voice from generic authority in three held-out passages.
territories.honest_limit: Confidence is too high when a concise sentence could plausibly belong to many leaders.

territories.name: Delegation
territories.evidence_sentence: A direct correction overturned the earlier claim that Maya fundamentally resists delegation.
territories.honest_limit: The replacement interpretation has not yet survived a held-out operating decision.

territories.name: Life outside work
territories.evidence_sentence: No evidence is requested or inferred here.
territories.honest_limit: This territory is outside the current proof by choice, not missing work.

timeline.headline: The first contour appeared.
timeline.change: Maya rejected polished work that created more options for her to rescue.

timeline.headline: A preference became a distinction.
timeline.change: Chosen and rejected work separated recognisable standards from generic polish.

timeline.headline: The distinction travelled.
timeline.change: The criteria held on unseen launch directions and one Brain-aided transfer attempt.

sources.assertion: I want them to bring me work that is nearly there, not more options I have to rescue.
The launch was polished, but it could have belonged to anyone.
I do not want a rulebook so tight that the next good idea gets rejected for being new.
Maya became precise only when comparing two concrete directions.
I do not need the team to imitate me. I need them to notice what I notice before I have to fix it.

holdouts.candidate: Polished category launch with no Aperture House-only point of view

Distinctive launch whose visual system overwhelms the customer problem
Unexpected creator-led direction with a clear company-specific claim

Longer editorial copy grounded in an uncomfortable specific observation
Concise copy with plausible but not distinctive authority
